Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on Wikipedia’s JSON-LD metadata that listed Tracy Flannigan’s nationality as “English,” an unreliable and contradictory field compared to the article’s framing and other sources indicating she is an American filmmaker. This misinterpretation of auto-generated metadata without cross-verification led toward the wrong nationality (English) instead of United States.
